title: Dallas JFK Culture + West End Food Tour by Food Tours of America
includes: West End foodie hop — enjoy 8 custom tastings at 3 restaurants, with plenty of food for a meal
Wild Bill’s Western Wear — explore a historic Dallas landmark with a shopping credit & included beer
Guided JFK experience — explore Dealey Plaza, the Grassy Knoll, Elm Street and JFK Memorial
Admission to The Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza (not included)
Additional alcoholic beverages — available for purchase at select locations only (not included)
Guide gratuity — not included and always appreciated
Transportation to and from the tour, parking fees (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

This is a walking tour through Downtown Dallas and the West End Historic District and may include sidewalks, curbs, street crossings and periods of standing. If you have accessibility or mobility needs, please contact Food Tours of America before your tour so we can provide additional information about the route and participating venues.

Guests should be comfortable walking approximately 1 mile and standing for portions of the 2.5-hour tour. The experience includes both indoor and outdoor portions, so please dress for the weather and wear comfortable walking shoes.
policies: At least 72 hours’ advance notice is required for dietary accommodations and menu substitutions. Please provide the name of each guest and their specific dietary restriction or food allergy when booking.
Booking within 72 hours? Please provide your dietary needs at the time of booking. We’ll do our best to accommodate last-minute requests, but some substitutions may be limited or unavailable.
All accommodations depend on each restaurant’s capabilities and cannot be guaranteed. Substitutions may differ from the standard tastings, and in some cases, fewer tastings may be available.

Severe or life-threatening food allergies: Our tours visit multiple independent restaurants, and we do not control their kitchens or the potential for cross-contact. For this reason, our tours may not be appropriate for guests with severe or life-threatening food allergies.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the history that brings visitors to Dallas. Explore the places and stories surrounding President John F. Kennedy’s assassination, including JFK Memorial Plaza, Dealey Plaza, the Grassy Knoll, X’s on Elm Street and the former Texas School Book Depository. Look toward the sixth-floor window associated with the official investigation as your guide puts November 22, 1963, into context, sharing what is known, what the official investigation concluded, and the conspiracy theories and questions that remain.

Continue through the West End Historic District, with 8 custom Food Tours of America tastings at 3 restaurants—plenty for a meal, featuring Latin and Indian favorites and distinctly Texas bison and venison. Step inside Wild Bill’s Western Wear, housed in a historic former drugstore, see its original late-1800s bar, and discover where a scene from Taylor Sheridan’s Dutton Ranch was filmed—all while enjoying an included beer.
